name: jira_operations
description:
Unified Jira MCP tool for Issue and Collaboration operations.

HOW TO USE
----------
Send a JSON object with an `operations` field set to one of the
operation names listed below exactly as written in the schema.
All other fields depend on the chosen operation. Fields marked *(required)* must always be supplied;
everything else is optional and has sensible defaults.

IMPORTANT: Whenever a field asks for an `issue_key`, you MUST
provide the actual Jira issue key (format: PROJECT-NUMBER),
NOT the issue title or summary text. If you only know the title,
first call Search Issues to resolve it to an issue key, then use
that key in subsequent operations.

================================================================
ISSUE OPERATIONS
================================================================

Create Issue — Create a new Jira issue or sub-task.
Fields:
    operations          *(required)* — Must be "Create Issue".
    summary             *(required)* — Issue title text.
    issue_type          — Issue type name. Default is Task.
                        For Sub-task, parent_key is REQUIRED.
    description         — Plain-text body of the issue.
    project_key         — Jira project key. Defaults to server-configured project.
    assignee_account_id — Atlassian account ID of the assignee.
    priority            — Priority name string.
    labels              — List of label strings.
    components          — List of component name strings.
    parent_key          — Parent issue key. REQUIRED when issue_type is Sub-task.
    custom_fields       — Dict of custom field IDs to values.

Get Issue — Retrieve full details of a single issue.
Fields:
    operations          *(required)* — Must be "Get Issue".
    issue_key           *(required)* — The Jira issue key.
    fields              — Comma-separated field names to return("summary,description,issuetype,project,status,priority,assignee,reporter etc."). Empty returns all.
    expand              — Comma-separated expansions to include.

Update Issue — Update one or more fields on an existing issue.
Fields:
    operations          *(required)* — Must be "Update Issue".
    issue_key           *(required)* — The Jira issue key.
    summary             — New title.
    description         — New description.
    assignee_account_id — New assignee account ID. Set to "__unassign__" to clear.
    priority            — New priority name.
    labels              — New label list (replaces existing).
    components          — New component list (replaces existing).
    custom_fields       — Dict of custom field updates.
    notify_users        — Boolean, default true. Send email notifications.

Delete Issue — Permanently delete an issue.
Fields:
    operations          *(required)* — Must be "Delete Issue".
    issue_key           *(required)* — The Jira issue key.
    delete_subtasks     — Boolean, default false. Set true to also delete sub-tasks.

Search Issues — Search for Jira issues using JQL or convenience filters.
Fields (all optional, provide at least project_key or jql):
    operations          *(required)* — Must be "Search Issues".
    jql                 — Raw JQL query string. If set, other filter fields are ignored.
    project_key         — Filter by project key.
    status              — Filter by status name.
    assignee            — Filter by assignee account ID or currentUser().
    issue_type          — Filter by issue type name.
    priority            — Filter by priority name.
    labels              — Comma-separated label names.
    text                — Free-text search across summary and description.
    max_results         — Maximum results to return (max 100, default 50).
    start_at            — Pagination offset (default 0).
    fields              — Comma-separated fields to return.
    order_by            — ORDER BY clause. Default is created DESC.

Assign Issue — Assign or unassign an issue.
Fields:
    operations          *(required)* — Must be "Assign Issue".
    issue_key           *(required)* — The Jira issue key.
    assignee_account_id — Account ID. Empty string or -1 to unassign.

================================================================
COLLABORATION OPERATIONS
================================================================

--- Transitions / Workflow ---

Get Transitions — Get available workflow transitions for an issue.
Fields:
    operations          *(required)* — Must be "Get Transitions".
    issue_key           *(required)* — The Jira issue key.

Transition Issue — Move an issue through a workflow transition.
Fields:
    operations          *(required)* — Must be "Transition Issue".
    issue_key           *(required)* — The Jira issue key.
    transition_id       — Numeric transition ID string. Use Get Transitions to find valid values.
    transition_name     — Transition name. Provide either transition_id or transition_name.
    comment             — Comment to add during the transition.
    resolution          — Resolution name.
    fields              — Dict of additional transition screen fields.

--- Comments ---

Add Comment — Add a comment to a Jira issue.
Fields:
    operations          *(required)* — Must be "Add Comment".
    issue_key           *(required)* — The Jira issue key.
    body                *(required)* — Comment text.
    visibility_type     — Set to group or role to restrict visibility. Empty for public.
    visibility_value    — Group or role name when visibility_type is set.

Get Comments — Get all comments on an issue.
Fields:
    operations          *(required)* — Must be "Get Comments".
    issue_key           *(required)* — The Jira issue key.
    max_results         — Default 50.
    start_at            — Pagination offset.
    order_by            — Use -created for newest first or +created for oldest first.

Update Comment — Edit an existing comment.
Fields:
    operations          *(required)* — Must be "Update Comment".
    issue_key           *(required)* — The Jira issue key.
    comment_id          *(required)* — Numeric comment ID string.
    body                *(required)* — New comment text.

Delete Comment — Delete a comment from an issue.
Fields:
    operations          *(required)* — Must be "Delete Comment".
    issue_key           *(required)* — The Jira issue key.
    comment_id          *(required)* — Numeric comment ID string. Use Get Comments to find IDs.

--- Worklogs ---

Add Worklog — Log time on a Jira issue.
Fields:
    operations          *(required)* — Must be "Add Worklog".
    issue_key           *(required)* — The Jira issue key.
    time_spent          *(required)* — Jira duration format string.
    comment             — Description of the work done.
    started             — ISO 8601 datetime when work started.

Get Worklogs — Get worklog entries for an issue.
Fields:
    operations          *(required)* — Must be "Get Worklogs".
    issue_key           *(required)* — The Jira issue key.
    max_results         — Default 50.
    start_at            — Pagination offset.

--- Watchers ---

Get Watchers — List all watchers of an issue.
Fields:
    operations          *(required)* — Must be "Get Watchers".
    issue_key           *(required)* — The Jira issue key.

Add Watcher — Add a user as a watcher.
Fields:
    operations          *(required)* — Must be "Add Watcher".
    issue_key           *(required)* — The Jira issue key.
    account_id          *(required)* — Atlassian account ID.

Remove Watcher — Remove a watcher from an issue.
Fields:
    operations          *(required)* — Must be "Remove Watcher".
    issue_key           *(required)* — The Jira issue key.
    account_id          *(required)* — Account ID of the watcher to remove.

--- Issue Links ---

Link Issues — Create a link between two issues.
Fields:
    operations          *(required)* — Must be "Link Issues".
    inward_issue_key    *(required)* — The inward Jira issue key.
    outward_issue_key   *(required)* — The outward Jira issue key.
    link_type           — Link type name. Default is Relates.
    comment             — Optional comment on the link.

Get Link Types — Get all available issue link types.
Fields: none.

Delete Link — Delete an issue link by its ID.
Fields:
    operations          *(required)* — Must be "Delete Link".
    link_id             *(required)* — Issue link ID string.

--- Votes ---

Get Votes — Get vote count and voters for an issue.
Fields:
    operations          *(required)* — Must be "Get Votes".
    issue_key           *(required)* — The Jira issue key.

Add Vote — Cast your vote on an issue.
Fields:
    operations          *(required)* — Must be "Add Vote".
    issue_key           *(required)* — The Jira issue key.

Remove Vote — Remove your vote from an issue.
Fields:
    operations          *(required)* — Must be "Remove Vote".
    issue_key           *(required)* — The Jira issue key.

--- Changelog ---

Get Changelog — Get the change history of an issue.
Fields:
    operations          *(required)* — Must be "Get Changelog".
    issue_key           *(required)* — The Jira issue key.
    max_results         — Default 50.
    start_at            — Pagination offset.

oneOf.description:
Create a new Jira issue or sub-task.

To create a **Sub-task** you MUST also provide `parent_key`.
Example: {"operations":"Create Issue","summary":"My subtask",
          "issue_type":"Sub-task","parent_key":"CPT-10"}

Supported issue types depend on your project configuration.
Use Get Issue Types to discover valid types for your project.

issue_type.description: Issue type name. Common values: "Task", "Bug", "Story", "Epic", "Sub-task". Type names are project-specific. Use Get Issue Types to list valid types. For Sub-task, parent_key is REQUIRED.

project_key.description: Jira project key, e.g. "CPT". Defaults to env JIRA_PROJECT_KEY if not set.

assignee_account_id.description: Atlassian account ID of the assignee. Use Get User or Find Assignable Users to look up IDs.

labels.description: List of label strings, e.g. ["backend", "urgent"]. Labels must already exist or be creatable.

components.description: Component names, e.g. ["API", "Frontend"]. Components must exist in the project.

parent_key.description: Parent issue key — REQUIRED when issue_type is "Sub-task", e.g. "CPT-10". In next-gen projects any issue can be a child providing both belong to the same project.
